title: Check Step Response Characteristics
text: Check that model signal satisfies step response bounds during simulation, 1 input, 1 output; {Show Plot} sets the open plot window, {Show plot on block open} sets the double-click block to open plot, {Response Optimization} sets the open Response Optimizer, {Include step response bound in assertion} sets the check that signal satisfies step response, {Step time} sets the time when step response bounds start, {Initial value} sets the signal value before step, {Final value} sets the signal value after step, {Rise time} sets the time taken to reach specified percentage of step, {% Rise} sets the percentage of step range value for rise, {Settling time (seconds)} sets the time taken to reach settling range, {% Settling} sets the tling range around final value, {% Overshoot} sets the amount by which signal can exceed final, {% Undershoot} sets the amount by which signal can undershoot initial, {Enable zero-crossing detection} sets the evaluate model at bound edges, {Enable assertion} enables or disable check, {Simulation callback when assertion fails (optional)} sets the expression to evaluate when assertion, {Stop simulation when assertion fails} sets the halt simulation when assertion fails and {Output assertion signal} sets the create output signal. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1 (u)
